ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web shown, what type of consumer is the lizard?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, at the top is plant (plant). There is an arrow from the plant pointing to ant (ant), below the ant is lizard (lizard), and there is also an arrow from the ant pointing to the lizard. Reasoning: Arrows indicate that food or energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Plants are producers; ants that eat plants are primary consumers; lizards eat ants, so lizards are secondary consumers.
